dn26:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati mātulāyaṃ.
dn26:1.7: attadīpā bhikkhave, viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.
dn26:1.8: kathañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo?
dn26:1.9: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn26:1.12: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn26:1.13: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
dn26:1.14: gocare bhikkhave, caratha sake pettike visaye.
dn26:1.15: gocare bhikkhave, carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati māro otāraṃ, na lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
dn26:1.16: kusalānaṃ bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ samādānahetu evamidaṃ puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati.
dn26:2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, rājā daḷhanemi nāma ahosi cakkavattī dhammiko rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn26:2.3: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
dn26:2.4: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā ahesuṃ sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn26:2.5: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasi.
dn26:3.1: atha kho bhikkhave, rājā daḷhanemi bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
dn26:3.2: “yadā tvaṃ ambho purisa passeyyāsi dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ, ṭhānā cutaṃ, atha me āroceyyāsī”ti.
dn26:3.3: ‘evaṃ devā’ti kho bhikkhave, so puriso rañño daḷhanemissa paccassosi.
dn26:3.4: addasā kho bhikkhave, so puriso bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ. disvāna yena rājā daḷhanemi tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ daḷhanemiṃ etadavoca:
dn26:3.5: yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibbaṃ te cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutanti.
dn26:3.6: atha kho bhikkhave, rājā daḷhanemi jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ āmantetvā etadavoca:
dn26:3.7: dibbaṃ kira me tāta kumāra cakkaratanaṃ osakkitaṃ ṭhānā cutaṃ.
dn26:3.9: ‘yassa rañño cakkavattissa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ osakkati, ṭhānā cavati, na’dāni tena raññā ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ hotī’ti.
dn26:3.10: bhuttā kho pana me mānusikā kāmā, samayo’dāni me dibbe kāme pariyesituṃ.
dn26:3.11: ehi tvaṃ tāta kumāra imaṃ samuddapariyantaṃ paṭhaviṃ paṭipajja.
dn26:3.12: ahaṃ pana kesamassuṃ ohāretvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmī”ti.
dn26:3.13: atha kho bhikkhave, rājā daḷhanemi jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ sādhukaṃ rajje samanusāsitvā, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
dn26:3.14: sattāhapabbajite kho pana bhikkhave, rājisimhi dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ antaradhāyi.
dn26:4.1: atha kho bhikkhave, aññataro puriso yena rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ khattiyaṃ muddhābhisittaṃ etadavoca:
dn26:4.2: yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ antarahitanti.
dn26:4.3: atha kho bhikkhave, rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto dibbe cakkaratane antarahite anattamano ahosi. anattamanatañca paṭisaṃvedesi.
dn26:4.4: so yena rājisi tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā rājisiṃ etadavoca:
dn26:4.5: yagghe deva jāneyyāsi dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ antarahitanti.
dn26:4.6: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave, rājisi rājānaṃ khattiyaṃ muddhābhisittaṃ etadavoca:
dn26:4.7: ‘mā kho tvaṃ tāta dibbe cakkaratane antarahite anattamano ahosi, mā anattamanatañca paṭisaṃvedesi na hi te tāta dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pettikaṃ dāyajjaṃ,
dn26:4.8: iṅgha tvaṃ tāta ariye cakkavattivatte vattāhi.
dn26:4.9: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yante ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānassa tadahuposathe paṇṇarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātu bhavissati sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūra”nti.
dn26:5.2: “tena hi tvaṃ tāta dhammaṃ yeva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garukaronto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno, dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhammādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ. dhammaṃ yeva nissāya …pe… balakāyasmiṃ dhammaṃ yeva nissāya khattiyesu anusuttesu. dhammaṃyeva nissāya …pe… brāhmaṇagahapatikesu, dhammaṃyeva nissāya …pe… negamajānapadesu, dhammaṃyeva nissāya samaṇabrāhmaṇesu, dhammaṃyeva nissāya …pe… migapakkhīsu.
dn26:5.3: mā ca te tāta vijite adhammakāro pavattittha.
dn26:5.4: ye ca te tāta vijite adhanā assu, tesañca dhanamanuppadeyyāsi
dn26:5.5: ye ca te tāta vijite samaṇabrāhmaṇā madappamādā paṭiviratā khantisoracce niviṭṭhā ekamattānaṃ damenti, ekamattānaṃ samenti, ekamattānaṃ parinibbāpenti. te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripuccheyyāsi pariñheyyāsi:
dn26:5.6: kiṃ bhante kusalaṃ, kiṃ akusalaṃ, kiṃ sāvajjaṃ kiṃ anavajjaṃ, kiṃ sevitabbaṃ kiṃ na sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya assa, kiṃ vā pana me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya assā?”ti.
dn26:5.7: tesaṃ sutvā yaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ abhinivajjeyyāsi, yaṃ kusalaṃ taṃ samādāya vatteyyāsi.
dn26:5.10: “evaṃ devā”ti kho bhikkhave rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto rājisissa paṭissutvā ariye cakkavattivatte vatti.
dn26:5.11: tassa ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānassa tadahuposathe paṇṇarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa
dn26:5.12: dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.
dn26:5.14: sutaṃ kho pana metaṃ yassa rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa tadahuposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nahātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavati. sahassāraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ, so hoti rājā cakkavattīti.
dn26:5.15: assaṃ nu kho ahaṃ rājā cakkavattī”ti.
dn26:6.1: atha kho bhikkhave, rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto uṭṭhāyāsanā, ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vāmena hatthena bhiṅkāraṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena cakkaratanaṃ abbhukkiri,

dn26:12.18: “tena hi bhaṇe imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā, kharassarena paṇavenarathiyā rathiṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sunisedhaṃ nisedhetha, mūlachejjaṃ karotha, sīsamassa chindathā”ti.
dn26:12.19: ‘evaṃ devā’ti kho bhikkhave te purisā rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa paṭissutvā taṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā, kharassarena paṇavena rathiyā rathiṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā, dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā, dakkhiṇato nagarassa sunisedhaṃ nisedhesuṃ mūlachejjaṃ akaṃsu, sīsamassa chindiṃsu.
dn26:13.2: “ye kira bho paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyanti, te rājā sunisedhaṃ nisedheti, mūlachejjaṃ karoti, sīsāni tesaṃ chindatī”ti.
dn26:13.4: yannūna mayampi tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpessāma tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpetvā yesaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyissāma, te sunisedhaṃ nisedhessāma, mūlachejjaṃ karissāma, sīsāni tesaṃ chindissāmā”ti.
dn26:13.5: te tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpesuṃ, tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpetvā gāmaghātakampi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nigamaghātampi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nagaraghātampi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, panthaduhanampi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ.
dn26:13.6: yesaṃ te adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyanti, te sunisedhaṃ nisedhenti, mūlachejjaṃ karonti, sīsāni tesaṃ chindanti.
dn26:14.1: iti kho bhikkhave, adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadīyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi. dāḷiddiye vepullaṃ gate adinnādānaṃ vepullamagamāsi. adinnādāne vepullaṃ gate satthaṃ vepullamagamāsi. satthe vepullaṃ gate pāṇātipāto vepullamagamāsi. pāṇātipāte vepullaṃ gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo pi parihāyi,
dn26:14.2: tesaṃ āyunāpi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ asītivassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ puttā cattārīsaṃ vassasahassāyukā ahesuṃ.
dn26:14.3: cattārīsaṃvassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi.
dn26:14.6: “ayaṃ deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyī”ti.
dn26:14.7: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave, rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto taṃ purisaṃ etadavoca:
dn26:14.8: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ ambho purisa paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyī?”ti.
dn26:15.1: iti kho bhikkhave, adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadīyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi. dāḷiddiye vepullaṃ gate adinnādānaṃ vepullamagamāsi. adinnādāne vepullaṃ gate satthaṃ vepullamagamāsi. satthe vepullaṃ gate pāṇātipāto vepullamagamāsi. pāṇātipāte vepullaṃ gate musāvādo vepullamagamāsi. musāvāde vepullaṃ gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo pi parihāyi.
dn26:15.2: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ cattārīsavassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:15.3: vīsativassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi.
dn26:15.4: tamenaṃ aññataro puriso rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa ārocesi:
dn26:15.5: “itthannāmo deva puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyī”ti pesuññamakāsi.
dn26:16.1: iti kho bhikkhave, adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadīyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi. dāḷiddiye vepullaṃ gate adinnādānaṃ vepullamagamāsi. adinnādāne vepullaṃ gate satthaṃ vepullamagamāsi. satthe vepullaṃ gate pāṇātipāto vepullamagamāsi. pāṇātipāte vepullaṃ gate musāvādo vepullamagamāsi. musāvāde vepullaṃ gate pisuṇā vācā vepullamagamāsi. pisuṇāya vācāya vepullaṃ gatāya tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi.
dn26:16.2: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ vīsativassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ dasavassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.1: dasavassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ekidaṃ sattā vaṇṇavanto honti, ekidaṃ sattā dubbaṇṇā.
dn26:17.2: tattha ye te sattā dubbaṇṇā, te vaṇṇavante satte abhijjhāyantā paresaṃ dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjiṃsu.
dn26:17.3: iti kho bhikkhave, adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadīyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi. dāḷiddiye vepullaṃ gate …pe… kāmesu micchācāro vepullamagamāsi. kāmesu micchācāre vepullaṃ gate tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi vaṇṇo pi parihāyi.
dn26:17.4: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ dasavassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ pañcavassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.5: pañcavassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu dve dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu
dn26:17.7: dvīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo pi parihāyi.
dn26:17.8: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ pañcavassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ appekacce aḍḍhateyyavassasahassāyukā appekacce dvevassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.10: abhijjhāvyāpādesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo pi parihāyi.
dn26:17.11: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ aḍḍhateyyavassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vassasahassāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.13: micchādiṭṭhiyā vepullaṃ gatāya tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo pi parihāyi.
dn26:17.14: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāya mānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi parihāyamānānaṃ vassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ pañcavassasatāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.15: pañcavassasatāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tayo dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu.
dn26:17.17: tīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo pi parihāyi.
dn26:17.18: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ pañca vassasatāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ appekacce aḍḍhateyyavassasatāyukā appekacce dvevassasatāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:17.19: aḍḍhateyyavassasatāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ime dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu
dn26:17.20: amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā na kulejeṭṭhāpacāyitā.
dn26:18.1: iti kho bhikkhave, adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadīyamāne dāḷiddiyaṃ vepullamagamāsi.
dn26:18.6: musāvāde vepullaṃ gate pisuṇā vācā vepullamagamāsi.
dn26:18.7: pisuṇāya vācāya vepullaṃ gatāya kāmesu micchācāro vepullamagamāsi.
dn26:18.8: kāmesu micchācāre vepullaṃ gate dve dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu, pharusā vācā samphappalāpo ca.
dn26:18.9: dvīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu abhijjhāvyāpādā’ vepullamagamaṃsu,
dn26:18.11: micchādiṭṭhiyā vepullaṃ gatāya tayo dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu adhammarāgo visamalobho micchādhammo,
dn26:18.12: tīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu ime dhammā vepullamagamaṃsu amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā na kulejeṭṭhāpacāyitā.
dn26:18.13: imesu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu pi parihāyi, vaṇṇopi parihāyi.
dn26:18.14: tesaṃ āyunā pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi parihāyamānānaṃ aḍḍhateyyavassasatāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vassasatāyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
dn26:19.1: bhavissati bhikkhave so samayo yaṃ imesaṃ manussānaṃ dasavassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:19.2: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu pañcavassikā kumārikā alampateyyā bhavissanti.
dn26:19.3: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu imāni rasāni antaradhāyissanti, seyyathidaṃ
dn26:19.4: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ.
dn26:19.5: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu kudrūsako aggaṃ bhojanānaṃ bhavissati.
dn26:19.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave etarahi sālimaṃsodano aggaṃ bhojanānaṃ,
dn26:19.7: evameva kho bhikkhave dasavassāyukesu manussesu kudrūsako aggaṃ bhojanānaṃ bhavissati.
dn26:19.8: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu dasakusalakammapathā sabbena sabbaṃ antaradhāyissanti, dasaakusalakammapathā atibyā dippissanti.
dn26:19.9: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu kusalantipi na bhavissati. kuto pana kusalassa kārako.
dn26:19.10: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ye te bhavissanti amatteyyā apetteyyā asāmaññā abrahmaññā na kule jeṭṭhāpacāyino, te pujjā ca bhavissanti pāsaṃsā ca.
dn26:19.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhave etarahi matteyyā petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kule jeṭṭhāpacāyino pujjā ca pāsaṃsā ca,
dn26:19.12: evameva kho bhikkhave dasavassāyukesu manussesu ye te bhavissanti amatteyyā apetteyyā asāmaññā abrahmaññā na kule jeṭṭhāpacāyino, te pujjā ca bhavissanti pāsaṃsā ca.
dn26:20.1: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu na bhavissati mātā ti vā mātucchā ti vā mātulānī ti vā ācariyabhariyā ti vā garūnaṃ dāro ti vā.
dn26:20.2: sambhedaṃ loko gamissati yathā ajeḷakā kukkuṭasūkarā soṇasigālā.
dn26:20.3: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ aññamaññamhi tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati, tibbo byāpādo, tibbo manopadoso, tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ
dn26:20.4: mātu pi puttamhi, puttassa pi mātari,
dn26:20.5: pitu pi puttamhi puttassa pi pitari,
dn26:20.6: bhātu pi bhātari, bhātu pi bhaginiyā, bhaginiyā pi bhātari, tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ.
dn26:20.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, māgavikassa migaṃ disvā tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito hoti tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ,
dn26:20.8: evameva kho bhikkhave, dasavassāyukesu manussesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ aññamaññamhi tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati tibbo byāpādo tibbo manopadoso tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ
dn26:20.9: mātu pi puttamhi, puttassa pi mātari,
dn26:20.10: pitu pi puttamhi, puttassa pi pitari,
dn26:20.11: bhātu pi bhātari, bhātu pi bhaginiyā, bhaginiyā pi bhātari, tibbo āghāto paccupaṭṭhito bhavissati, tibbo byāpādo, tibbo manopadoso, tibbaṃ vadhakacittaṃ.
dn26:21.1: dasavassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu sattāhaṃ satthantarakappo bhavissati.
dn26:21.4: te tiṇhena satthena ‘esa migo esa migo’ti aññamaññaṃ jīvitā voropessanti.
dn26:21.5: āyuvaṇṇādivaḍḍhanakathā atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ ekaccānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati,
dn26:21.6: ‘mā ca mayaṃ kañci, mā ca amhe koci, yannūna mayaṃ tiṇagahaṇaṃ vā vanagahaṇaṃ vā rukkhagahaṇaṃ vā nadīviduggaṃ vā pabbatavisamaṃ vā pavisitvā vanamūlaphalāhārā yāpeyyāmā’ti.
dn26:21.7: te tiṇagahaṇaṃ vā vanagahaṇaṃ vā rukkhagahaṇaṃ vā nadīviduggaṃ vā pabbatavisamaṃ vā pavisitvā sattāhaṃ vanamūlaphalāhārā yāpessanti.
dn26:21.8: te tassa sattāhassa accayena tiṇagahaṇā vanagahaṇā rukkhagahaṇā nadīviduggā pabbatavisamā nikkhamitvā aññamaññaṃ āliṅgitvā sabhāgāyissanti samassāsissanti
dn26:21.9: ‘diṭṭhā bho satta jīvasi, diṭṭhā bho satta jīvasī’ti.
dn26:21.11: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati
dn26:21.12: ‘mayaṃ kho akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu evarūpaṃ āyataṃ ñātikkhayaṃ pattā
dn26:21.15: yannūna mayaṃ pāṇātipātā virameyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā”ti.
dn26:21.16: te pāṇātipātā viramissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti.
dn26:21.17: te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunā pi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhissanti.
dn26:21.18: tesaṃ āyunā pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ dasavassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:22.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati,
dn26:22.2: “mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunā pi vaḍḍhāma, vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhāma.
dn26:22.17: te pāṇātipātā viramissanti adinnādānā viramissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti.
dn26:22.18: te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunā’pi vaḍḍhissanti, vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhissanti.
dn26:22.19: tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vīsativassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattālīsativassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:22.20: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ kāmesumicchācārā virameyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ cattālīsavassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ asītivassāyukā puttā bhavissanti. atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ musāvādā virameyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ
dn26:22.21: asītivassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ saṭṭhivassasatāyukā puttā bhavissanti. atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ pisuṇāya vācāya virameyyāma idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti. pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ
dn26:22.23: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ pharusāya vācāya virameyyāma. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti, pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti, pharusāya vācāya viramissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vīsaṃtivassasatāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattārīsaṃjabbassasatāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:22.24: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ samphappalāpā virameyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti. pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti, pharusāya vācāya viramissanti, samphappalāpā viramissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ cattārīsaṃjabbassasatāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ dvevassasahassāyukā puttā bhavissanti. atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ abhijjhaṃ pajaheyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti. pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti, pharusāya vācāya viramissanti, samphappalāpā viramissanti. abhijjhaṃ pajahissanti, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ
dn26:22.25: dvevassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ cattārivassasahassāyukā puttā bhavissanti. atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ vyāpādaṃ pajaheyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ ‘dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti. pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti, pharusāya vācāya viramissanti, samphappalāpā viramissanti, abhijjhaṃ pajahissanti, vyāpādaṃ pajahissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ
dn26:22.26: cattārivassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ aṭṭhavassasahassāyukā puttā bhavissanti. atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ micchādiṭṭhiṃ pajaheyyāma, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti, pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti, pharusāya vācāya viramissanti, samphappalāpā viramissanti, abhijjhaṃ pajahissanti, vyāpādaṃ pajahissanti, micchādiṭṭhiṃ pajahissanti. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ
dn26:22.27: aṭṭhavassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāyukā puttā bhavissanti, atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati: ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāmāti. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ tayo dhamme pajaheyyāma adhammarāgaṃ visamalobhaṃ micchādhammaṃ, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti, pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti, pharusāya vācāya viramissanti, samphappalāpā viramissanti, abhijjhaṃ pajahissanti, vyāpādaṃ pajahissanti, micchādiṭṭhiṃ pajahissanti, tayo dhamme pajahissanti: adhammarāgaṃ visamalobhaṃ micchādhammaṃ. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti, vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti, tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ
dn26:23.2: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati ‘mayaṃ kho kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhāma vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhāma. yannūna mayaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kusalaṃ kareyyāma. kiṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma? yannūna mayaṃ matteyyā assāma petteyyā assāma sāmaññā brahmaññā kulejeṭṭhāpacāyino, idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vatteyyāmā’ti. te pāṇātipātā viramissanti, adinnādānā viramissanti, kāmesumicchācārā viramissanti, musāvādā viramissanti, pisuṇāya vācāya viramissanti, pharusāya vācāya viramissanti, samphappalāpā viramissanti, abhijjhaṃ pajahissanti, vyāpādaṃ pajahissanti, micchādiṭṭhiṃ pajahissanti, tayo dhamme pajahissanti: adhammarāgaṃ visamalobhaṃ micchādhammaṃ, matteyyā bhavissanti petteyyā sāmaññā brahmaññā kulejeṭṭhāpacāyino. idaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ samādāya vattissanti. te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunāpi vaḍḍhissanti vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunāpi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇenapi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ cattārīsaṃvassasahassāyukānaṃ manussānaṃ asītivassasahassāyukā puttā bhavissanti.
dn26:23.3: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu paṃcavassasatikā kumārikā alampateyyā bhavissanti.
dn26:23.5: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu tayo ābādhā bhavissanti icchā anasanaṃ jarā.
dn26:23.6: saṅkharājuppatti asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo iddho ceva bhavissati phīto ca, kukkuṭasampātikā gāmanigamajanapada rājadhāniyo.
dn26:23.7: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo avīci maññe phuṭo bhavissati manussehi, seyyathāpi naḷavanaṃ saravanaṃ vā.
dn26:23.8: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ayaṃ bārāṇasī ketumatī nāma rājadhāni bhavissati iddhā ceva phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.
dn26:23.9: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu imasmiṃ jambudīpe caturāsīti nagarasahassāni bhavissanti ketumatīrājadhānipamukhāni.
dn26:24.1: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu ketumatiyā rājadhāniyā saṃkho nāma rājā uppajjissati cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn26:24.3: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
dn26:24.4: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavissanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn26:24.5: so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasissati.
dn26:25.1: asītivassasahassāyukesu bhikkhave manussesu metteyyo nāma bhagavā loke uppajjissati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
dn26:25.2: seyyathāpahaṃ etarahi loke uppanno arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
dn26:25.3: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedessati, seyyathāpahaṃ etarahi imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedemi.
dn26:25.4: so dhammaṃ desessati ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsessati.
dn26:25.5: seyyathāpahaṃ etarahi dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
dn26:25.6: so anekasatasahassaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissati seyyathāpahaṃ etarahi anekasataṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharāmi.
dn26:26.1: atha kho bhikkhave, saṅkho nāma rājā yo so yūpo raññā mahāpanādena kārāpito,
dn26:26.2: taṃ yūpaṃ ussāpetvā ajjhāvasitvā taṃ datvā vissajjetvā samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavaṇibbakayācakānaṃ dānaṃ datvā metteyyassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati.
dn26:26.3: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno eko vūpakaṭṭhe appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati.
dn26:27.1: attadīpā bhikkhave, viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā.
dn26:27.2: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo?
dn26:27.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn26:27.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
dn26:27.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo, dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo.
dn26:28.1: gocare bhikkhave, caratha sake pettike visaye.
dn26:28.2: gocare bhikkhave carantā sake pettike visaye āyunā pi vaḍḍhissatha, vaṇṇena pi vaḍḍhissatha, sukhena pi vaḍḍhissatha, bhogena pi vaḍḍhissatha, balena pi vaḍḍhissatha.
dn26:28.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti,
dn26:28.8: so imesaṃ catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
dn26:28.11: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dn26:28.14: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn26:28.18: idaṃ kho pana bhikkhave bhikkhuno sukhasmiṃ.
dn26:28.20: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati. idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu
dn26:28.23: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
dn26:28.26: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn26:28.28: nāhaṃ bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekabalampi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ duppasahaṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave mārabalaṃ
dn26:28.29: kusalānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ samādānahetu evamidaṃ puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatīti.
dn26:28.31: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
